facebook.caption:
9,703 reviews. Most tourists still walk past this place.

Phu Quoc Prison History Museum is one of the most important sites on the island. French colonial-era prison. Used to hold Vietnamese POWs during the war. Mannequins recreate the torture methods used inside these walls.

It is not comfortable. That is the point.

Free or low-cost entry. 1-2 hours is enough. Go before the midday heat hits.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walking through cells built to break people. Phu Quoc Prison History Museum. 9,703 ratings and still off most tourist itineraries. Add it to your list.
